sentences.text:
The brief facts necessary for the disposal of this appeal are as follows:
An extent of 0.022 Hectares of land comprised in Survey No.183/2-1 of Peroor Village in Kottayam Taluk was acquired for the upgradation of the Moovattupuzha-Ettumanoor-Chengannoor State Highway.
The notification under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act was published on 23.03.2009.

The Land Acquisition Officer, on finding the land to be reclaimed land situated on the eastern side of the M.C. Road relied upon a Sale Deed No.2619/2007 dated 23.09.2007 to arrive at a market value of Rs.98,170/- per Are in relation to the acquired property.
3. Aggrieved by the fixation of the market value by the Land Acquisition Officer, the claimant approached the Reference Court for an enhancement of the market value.

The Reference Court, on finding that the acquired property, although a reclaimed property lying on the side of M.C.Road, was nevertheless in a developed area, felt that the reduction effected by the Land Acquisition Officer to the value of Rs.3,57,143/- per Are in Sale Deed No.2619/2007 referred above was not justified.
The Reference LA.APP. NO. 517 OF 2015 3 2025:KER:37296 Court, therefore, proceeded to enhance the market value of the land to Rs.3,57,143/- per Are and refixed the compensation on that basis.
4. Before us, the State is in appeal in an attempt to reduce the market value of the land as fixed by the Reference Court.

When the matter was taken up for hearing, however, the learned Government Pleader brings to our notice, the judgment of this Court dated 31.01.2023 in LA.App. No.463 of 2013 where in the context of acquisition in a proximate area of the same highway pursuant to a Section 4(1) notification issued on 15.12.2007, the market value of the land was fixed at Rs.5,40,000/- Per Are.

It is the fair submission of the learned Government Pleader that in the absence of any further appeal against the said judgment of this Court in LA.App.No.463 of 2013, and further in the absence of any appeal preferred by the claimant in the instant case, the fixation of the market value by the Reference Court may not call for any interference.

Taking note of the judgment of this Court in LA.App.No.463 of 2013 and finding that a higher market value has been fixed for lands in the vicinity of the lands acquired in the instant appeal, we deem it appropriate to dismiss this LA.Appeal and affirm the judgment of the Reference Court, that is impugned in this appeal.
